findings.claim: The frozen rubric requires that an ident rewrite fails closed with tree integrity: <path>, but the plan's v2 design (every .gitattributes removed before checkout-index, empty work-tree, core.attributesFile=/dev/null, GIT_ATTR_NOSYSTEM=1) makes an ident rewrite structurally unreachable, so the plan instead tests that $Id$ stays literal and the build succeeds. The fail-closed integrity branch is exercised only via the separate tampered-tree fixture, which is an equivalent-or-stronger guarantee, but the rubric sentence is not literally covered by a fixture in which an ident rewrite occurs and is caught.
findings.evidence: Rubric R3 text: 'an ident rewrite fails closed with tree integrity: <path>'. Plan §1.1: attributes are stripped before checkout, then the removed .gitattributes blobs are written raw; verified sentinel smudge never runs and $Id$ stays literal. Plan test (h2): 'id.txt ident ... is NOT rewritten (attributes are inert) and the build succeeds with the literal bytes, while a tampered tree ... fails closed with tree integrity: <path>'.
findings.evidence_reference: FROZEN_RUBRIC R3 sentence 4; PLAN_UNDER_REVIEW §1.1 integrity paragraph and §2 review-packet.test.sh item (h2)
findings.repair: No current change; follow-up only. When implementing (h2), additionally assert the integrity helper directly on a synthetic $Id$-expanded copy of id.txt (or keep the existing tampered-tree seam) so the rubric's fail-closed-on-ident-rewrite branch has an explicit RED-at-base-pinned witness even though the checkout path can no longer trigger it.

findings.affected_surface: hooks/tests/review-packet.test.sh and the ident integrity contract
findings.claim: The plan directly contradicts the frozen requirement for an ident rewrite to fail closed.
findings.evidence: Frozen R3 requires an ident rewrite to fail with 'tree integrity: <path>'. Plan section 2(h2) instead requires id.txt to remain literal and the build to succeed, while a separate generic mutation exercises the integrity failure. That does not provide the frozen ident-specific evidence.
findings.evidence_reference: Frozen rubric R3; plan section 2, review-packet.test.sh item h2; plan acceptance criterion packet-hazards
findings.repair: Retain the production assertion that attributes are inert, but make the integrity-helper mutation a Git-style ident expansion and assert 'tree integrity: id.txt' with no MANIFEST.json. Otherwise the controller must reconcile the frozen rubric before implementation.

findings.claim: The proposed checkout does not actually prevent all attribute-driven filters from executing.
findings.evidence: The plan removes tracked .gitattributes and disables system and global attributes, but checkout-index still uses the repository's real Git directory. Git also consults $GIT_DIR/info/attributes, which the proposed GIT_INDEX_FILE, empty work-tree, core.attributesFile and GIT_ATTR_NOSYSTEM controls do not disable. A filter or ident rule there can run before the integrity pass; detecting changed bytes afterward cannot undo filter side effects.
findings.evidence_reference: Plan section 1.1 private-index checkout procedure; plan section 2(h2); global constraint stating that no attribute-driven filter can run
findings.repair: Run checkout-index through an isolated temporary Git directory that shares only the required object database and contains no info attributes or inherited filter configuration. Add a fixture using repository info attributes and a sentinel filter, and assert the filter is never invoked.

findings.affected_surface: src/runners/review-packet.js diff section alignment and deny filtering
findings.claim: A section-count check alone does not establish that input diff sections correspond to the name-status records used for deny decisions.
findings.evidence: The plan specifies positional one-for-one pairing and failure only on a count mismatch. It does not validate each section's old and new paths or prove that diffFile is the canonical diff for the resolved commits. An equal-count reordered or substituted diff can therefore pair a denied record with an allowed section and retain a denied section.
findings.evidence_reference: Plan section 1.1 diff.patch algorithm; plan section 2 review-packet assertions c and f; frozen rubric R1
findings.repair: Before filtering, either byte-validate diffFile against a freshly generated canonical diff for the resolved commits or robustly validate every section's old and new path against its name-status record. Add an equal-count reordered-section fixture that must fail closed.
